description: This file defines the IDeviceDiagnostics interface for device diagnostics, including methods for registration, configuration retrieval, milestone logging, and decoder status monitoring, along with associated data structures and notifications.

classes.name: IDeviceDiagnostics
classes.description: Interface for device diagnostics operations, including configuration, milestones, and decoder status notifications.

classes.name: IDeviceDiagnostics::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for device diagnostics events, such as AV decoder status changes.

classes.name: IDeviceDiagnostics::ParamList
classes.description: Data structure representing a property name-value pair.

classes.name: IDeviceDiagnostics::AvDecoderStatusResult
classes.description: Data structure holding the AV decoder status string.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for device diagnostics events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: GetConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves configuration properties based on provided property names.

methods.name: GetAVDecoderStatus
methods.description: Gets the current status of the AV decoder pipeline.
